name: alpha-steps
airframe: any jet - fly it LOADED (heavy stores) for the loaded-jet case
note: TRANSIENT half of the alpha pair (alpha-sweep is the sustained half). Mirrored +-45 deg pitch steps at 8000 m: thin air is the airframe-agnostic lever that makes the WING hit its alpha ceiling before the g-limit, and a 45 deg step is the fast pull the v0.57 predictive gate exists for. The arm between the steps returns to level so both are true 45 deg steps from the same datum; they are NOT matched in entry ENERGY (see cards/README.md).
